Maria Chen: Heads-up — we're publishing the benchmarking blog on Wed 2026-05-06 at 17:00 UTC. Need alignment on press outreach + embargo. Target: Tech press + trade; APAC embargo lift earlier. Docs here: https://redwood.in/pulse-bench (contains quotes and FAQs)
Devon Park: @Maria got it. Are we doing single global embargo or staggered by region?
Maria Chen: Staggered. APAC lift 08:00 HKT (00:00 UTC), EMEA 09:00 BST (09:00 UTC), NA 13:00 ET (17:00 UTC). Will send canonical schedule.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare the social calendar. Confirming native syndication windows and influencer outreach windows. Any legal flags?
Li Wong: Quick check — the quote from CEO is cleared. But the benchmarking methodology paragraph needs a footnote. I'll attach a one-liner we must include.
PressBot: Publish checklist created: /checklists/pulse-bench-publish. Status: draft -> needs approvals from: Devon Park, Li Wong, Maria Chen
Devon Park: For press outreach — we'll embargo tech press until NA lift. Trade outlets can run at EMEA time. Press kit ready: https://drive.redwood/pulse-kit
Timea Novak: Suggest we do a soft tweet at APAC lift and a full thread at NA lift. Also schedule a community thread on Hacker News at NA lift + 15m.
Maria Chen: Copy. Samir, can you post a UTC schedule block for engineering ops?
Samir Patel: Sure. Posting schedule:
```
2026-05-06 00:00 UTC — APAC soft blog release (site live, social soft)
2026-05-06 09:00 UTC — EMEA trade press pickup
2026-05-06 17:00 UTC — NA full press outreach + HN thread
```
I'll set up CMS publish and CDN cache warm.
Devon Park: I'll send embargo emails to top contacts with the press kit and embargo times. Template in /PR/templates/embargo-email.md
Maria Chen: Final note — if we see early pickup before NA lift, we fallback to "public statement" plan in the playbook. @Devon please prep a short reactive statement.
Devon Park: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Timea Novak: All set from growth side. Monitoring dashboard will watch mentions + traffic spikes. :binoculars:
Maria Chen: Awesome — if no objections, we'll lock the schedule by EOD today.
Devon Park: Locking it now.
